source_scope: public-source major industry events; recent-first where available; mapped to PatchTST role+direction pairs
notes: event_catalog is compiled from official/public web sources to avoid GDELT keyword noise.
role_trend_evidence maps PatchTST canonical_role + trend_direction to 3-5 reusable event_ids.
